book.name: 1 TIMOTEO
book.title: JA' AN SBABEL CARTA NAJ PABLO TET NAJ TIMOTEO

content: Tzet Utbil Chi Yun Yoc Txa
Ja' tinani', chi babi walontoj jun ti' e ach. Sowalil chi cu k'an tet Dios, chi cu txali yu masanil ánima. Sowalil chi cu k'an tet Dios, catu' chi kalon pax yu diosalil yu eb ánima tu'.

Sowalil chi cu txali yu eb mimej yaaw, c'al yu eb yaaw masanil, yet watx' yin ojab watx' c'ulal ey jon ec' yetoj eb, catu' c'am ojab jowal cu xol yetoj eb. Ta jaxca tu' oj ske' kunen tzet chi ẍa' sc'ul Dios. Oj ske' cu wa'nen oc cu beybal.
Ta jaxca tu' chi kute cu ba, watx' yul sat Dios cu Colomal, catu' caw chi tzala naj ketoj.
Yutol chi yoche naj chi colcha ánima masanil. Chi yoche naj chi yotajne el jun cuybanile ja' caw yel eb.
Asan jun Dios ey. Catu' asan pax jun yalomal oc cu ti' tet, ja' ton naj Jesucristo, ja' ton naj jix oc animail.
Jix jul yak' cam sba naj, yet watx' chi ske' scolcha can masanil ánima yu. Ja' yet jix jul stiempoal yu chi al-le el oj, jix al-le el sk'aneal.

Jix ak'le wopiso walon el jun k'aneal ti' jainti' an. Jix jin ale oc ẍejab oj Jesucristo an. Yu jun tu', yuxan jix ak'le pax wopiso jin cuyon eb man Israel oj yin jun cuybanile caw yel, yet watx' chi yaoc sc'ul eb yin Cristo. Caw yel chi wal an, tol ey oc jin c'ul yin Cristo. Man tu' c'al oj chi wal an.
Yuxan, chi woche chi txali eb winaj bey jun jun lugar. Ja' eb chi yi' a can sk'ab catu' chi txali, sowalil ojab watx' sbeybal eb yul sat Dios.
C'am ojab ẍichon c'ulal eb. Man ojab ak'om jowal oj eb.

Ja' eb ix ix, bey c'al ian ojab chi yute spichon sba eb ix, tool ojab chi yute yaon oc spichil eb ix. Man ojab ey xa smey oj chi yute xil ya' eb. Manchej smeyne sba eb yaon oc ch'en oro chi tzejeji yili, c'al ch'en ch'en yel xa c'al miman stool. Manchej smeyne sba eb yetoj pichile yel xa c'al miman stool.
Ja' ti' yet eb, ja' ojab watx' beybale chi x'ox el eb. Smoo watx' chi yute sba eb, yutol yet xa Dios ye eb.
Yi' ojab ey sba ix ix yaben scuybanil eb, catu' tz'in ojab c'al ẍi eb ix yet chi yaben scuybanil.
Jain chi wal an, tol c'am chi ske' scuywa eb ix xol winaj. Ma ske' tol ja' eb ix oj ak'on mandar winaj. Yab ojab eb ix, c'am ojab chi yaltoj yet eb ix.
Yutol babel wa'nebil naj Adán yu Dios. Tzunan to jix wa'nele ix Eva.
Manaj naj Adán jix i'le eytej sat yu naj diablo, pero ja' ix Eva, yuxan ja' ix jix ey q'uey yin spenail tet Dios.
Ja' ilo ch'ib unin yopiso eb ix. Oj colcha eb ix, yutol chi yaoc Dios eb ix yin sc'ul. Ta ey scam c'ulal eb ix, ta watx' sbeybal eb ix yul sat Dios, ta chi yak' cuenta sba eb ix.

footnotes.text: Beybalnebil yu eb creyente yet tu', tol chi yi' a can sk'ab yet chi txali eb.
